extraction.Name: Victoria Prue or Yellow Bird
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded by C. L. Dice on February 21, 1919
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged on two occasions; the first February 10, 1918 for $1500.00, and the second May 28, 1919, for $500.00. Conveyed by deed signed by Victoria Prue on March 27, 1920 to H. G. Davis for $3500.00, subject to the two mortgages.
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612734 issued; southeast quarter of section 26, township 38, range 26; receipt for patent signed by allottee on January 31, 1918.
